title: Senior Systems Administrator (Tableau servers)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Tableau Server Administrator to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.   • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to explain and understand problems effectively
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills
  • Time zone: Pacific Time Zone preferred, but flexibility is possible

Garantir que as soluções estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de longo prazo da empresa, como transformação digital, e-commerce e otimização da cadeia de suprimentos global.
  • Conhecimento Multicamadas : Fornecer liderança arquitetônica em todas as camadas da rede — desde a Camada 1 (física) , incluindo fibra óptica, até Camadas 2 e 3 (switching, roteamento e protocolos).   • Camada 1 : Fibra óptica, DWDM;
  • Camada 2 : Ethernet, switching;
  • Camada 3 : Roteamento IP, BGP, OSPF.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação : Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos em linguagem clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

  • Role

O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).

title: Product Owner
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Sobre a área:

A área de Produto Digital é responsável por evoluir os produtos da empresa, garantindo alta performance, experiência do usuário diferenciada e integração com os demais. Temos como objetivo aumentar a adoção, engajamento e satisfação dos usuários, assegurando entregas alinhadas às estratégias de negócio e à qualidade técnica esperada.


Principais atividades:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras. Tomar decisões de Go/No Go da entrega na Review;

Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar na gestão de aplicativos digitais , com foco especial no aplicativo de resultados de exames , garantindo priorização assertiva das demandas e interlocução com diferentes áreas e regionais. Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad , garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da área. Também terá atuação próxima do time digital localizado em São Paulo , influenciando e direcionando prioridades de forma indireta e estruturada.

Buscamos alguém com conhecimento aprofundado sobre as lojas da Apple e Google , incluindo políticas, publicações e boas práticas de atualização de aplicativos.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e com critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras.
  • Realizar análise de mercado e benchmarking para identificar tendências em aplicativos e canais digitais.
  • Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades com usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders e garantir a comunicação clara sobre estratégias e ações.

Se você tem perfil estratégico, domínio de aplicativos digitais e gosta de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: 5x2

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python

  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem

Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Software Engineer (L5)
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.

  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Analista de manutenção
description:

A Asgaard Bourbon Navegação (ABN) é uma empresa brasileira dedicada à prestação de serviços marítimos para a indústria offshore. Com sede no Rio de Janeiro, atua ao longo da costa brasileira oferecendo soluções eficientes e seguras.

A ABN opera uma frota de embarcações especializadas, como AHTS (Anchor Handling Tug Supply) e OSRV (Oil Spill Response Vessel), preparadas para atender a diversas operações no setor, incluindo abastecimento, reboque, manuseio de âncoras e manutenção de terminais oceânicos.

A empresa se destaca pelo compromisso com a segurança, ética, transparência e respeito às pessoas e ao meio ambiente, contando com uma equipe qualificada e engajada em oferecer excelência nos serviços prestados.

  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de manutenções programadas em docagens e paradas técnicas.
  • Solicitar orçamentos, negociar com prestadores de serviços e acompanhar a execução até o fechamento contratual, assegurando qualidade, prazos e custos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Suprimentos, Operações e QSMS, garantindo a conformidade com procedimentos internos e normas de segurança.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da manutenção e propor melhorias nos processos.
  • Manter a gestão documental e o histórico de manutenções atualizados, conforme padrões internos e requisitos contratuais.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

Senior Technical Recruiter


About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Technical Recruiter to join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in driving our growth. As a key member of our Talent Acquisition team, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and closing top-tier tech talent across the Americas. A Corelaser é referência em soluções avançadas para saúde regenerativa e ortobiologia, oferecendo tecnologias inovadoras em terapias autólogas, laser médico e biomateriais de última geração. Nosso compromisso é aliar ciência, segurança e tecnologia para transformar resultados clínicos.

  • Experiência em ortobiológicos, processamento celular ou terapias regenerativas .
  • Conhecimento das normas da RDC 508/2021  e boas práticas em procedimentos autólogos.

Location: Brazil/ Remote

Job Type: Full-time contract



About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.



Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.



About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.


What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.



Key Responsibilities


, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.


Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno

Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Possui expertise na implementação de Identity Providers (IdP), Resource Servers e Authorization Servers, bem como na configuração de clients OAuth2 com grant types como Authorization Code, Client Credentials, e Refresh Tokens.

Também é responsável por definir estratégias de controle de acesso baseado em roles (RBAC) e atributos (ABAC), configuração de políticas de autorização, integração com diretórios corporativos (LDAP, AD), e hardening de endpoints REST com escopos e claims personalizados.

Competências Técnicas

Linguagem: Java 8–21

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel

SSO & Identity: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML 2.0, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure Active Directory, Okta

Segurança: Criptografia, JWK/JWS, HTTPS/TLS, CORS, CSRF, PKCE

Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM

Testes: Testcontainers, JUnit, Mockito, integração com testes de segurança

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD com Jenkins, GitLab ou GitHub Actions

Diferenciais

Experiência na migração de sistemas legados para arquiteturas modernas com SSO.

Atuação direta no desenho e implementação de Identity Providers e Authorization Servers próprios.

Capacidade de liderar times na definição de padrões de autenticação e segurança em ambientes corporativos.

Vivência com compliance de segurança, como LGPD e GDPR, aplicando princípios de privacy-by-design.

Diferencial: com conhecimento em Autenticação, Autorização e SSO com OAuth2Habilidades:


Hardskills:


- Java

- Spring Boot

- Spring Security

- Spring Authorization Server

- OAuth2

- OpenID Connect

- JWT

- Keycloak

- Azure Active Directory

- Docker

- Kubernetes


Softskills:


- Autonomia, Proatividade e Iniciativa

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Financial Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Financial Analyst will play a critical role in driving business decision-making through comprehensive financial analysis, reporting, and strategic insights. This position requires advanced analytical skills to evaluate financial performance, develop forecasts, and identify opportunities for organizational growth and optimization.


Key Responsibilities:


-Analyzing financial data and preparing comprehensive reports and presentations.

-Developing and maintaining financial models for forecasting and budgeting purposes.

-Monitoring key performance indicators and providing variance analysis.

-Supporting business units with financial planning and strategic initiatives.

-Collaborating with cross-functional teams to evaluate investment opportunities and business cases.

-Assisting in month-end and quarter-end financial reporting processes.


Requirements:


-Experience: 3+ years in financial analysis or related roles

-Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of financial modeling and analysis techniques

-Software Proficiency: Expertise in Excel and financial analysis software

-Accounting: Understanding of accounting principles and financial statement analysis

-Analytical Abilities: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

-Communication: Ability to present complex financial information clearly

-Language: Advanced level of English



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: 10981 - Arquiteto de Sistemas .NET
description:
Estamos em buscando um Arquiteto de Sistemas .NET , para atuar e empresa de Tecnologia & Inovação! ✨


Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Experiência em arquitetura de sistemas ou papel equivalente (Tech Lead / Staff / Sr. Eng.) em produtos de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência sólida com C#/.NET (Core/7/8) e SQL Server (otimização e tuning);
  • Vivência prática com containers (Docker/Kubernetes), microserviços e mensageria;
  • Experiência em cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) com serviços gerenciados;
  • Definição de APIs (REST/GraphQL), autenticação/autorização (OAuth2/OIDC);
  • Conhecimentos em observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing distribuído);
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e Infra as Code;


Diferenciais;

  • Event Sourcing, outbox pattern, gRPC e Service Mesh;
  • Cache distribuído (Redis), API Gateway (APIM/Kong/YARP);
  • NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB) e Elasticsearch;
  • Certificações relevantes (Azure Architect, AWS SA, CKA/CKAD);


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetura & Design;
  • Definir a arquitetura de referência e roadmap de evolução;
  • Modelar sistemas com boas práticas (DDD, arquitetura hexagonal, modularização, CQRS quando aplicável);
  • Estabelecer padrões de API (REST/GraphQL), contratos e versionamento;
  • Escalabilidade & Performance;
  • Definir estratégias de caching, resiliência e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus);
  • Apoiar times em capacity planning, testes de carga e tuning de aplicações e banco de dados (SQL Server);
  • Boas práticas de Segurança e Governança;
  • Considerar segurança by design (OAuth2/OIDC, gestão de segredos, OWASP Top 10) nas decisões arquiteturais;
  • Apoiar a adequação à LGPD e governança de dados (uso responsável, retenção e privacidade);
  • Cloud & DevOps;
  • Orientar decisões em IaaS/PaaS/Serverless;
  • Apoiar padrões de CI/CD e Infra as Code (Terraform/Bicep);
  • Contribuir para observabilidade ponta a ponta (logs, métricas e tracing);
  • Governança & Cultura Técnica;
  • Documentar decisões arquiteturais (ADRs) e guidelines;
  • Facilitar design reviews, post-mortems e boas práticas de código;
  • Mentorar e influenciar times técnicos.


Contratação: CLT + benefícios

Modelo Híbrido: Centro/Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: .NET Core Developer - Advanced English - Remote
description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 227,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering and cloud, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2022 totaled $12.1 billion.


To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Key Responsibilities:

1. Full Stack Development :

- Design, develop, and maintain both front-end and back-end code using .NET Core/ASP.NET , C# , JavaScript , and related technologies.

- Build interactive, responsive, and dynamic user interfaces using HTML5 , CSS3 , JavaScript , and modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React , Angular , or Vue.js ).

- Implement RESTful APIs and integrate with front-end UI for a seamless user experience.

2. Database Management :

- Design, develop, and optimize database structures using SQL Server or other relational databases.

- Write efficient SQL queries, stored procedures, and ensure database performance and scalability.

3. Collaboration :

- Work closely with other developers, designers, and product managers to ensure that the applications meet business requirements and deliver a high-quality user experience.

- Participate in code reviews, providing feedback on design and implementation, and following best practices for development.

4. Troubleshooting and Debugging :

- Identify and fix software defects and performance issues across the entire stack.

- Optimize both front-end performance (e.g., load times) and back-end efficiency (e.g., query optimization, scalability).

5. Testing and Documentation :

- Write unit tests and perform integration testing to ensure high code quality and stability.

- Maintain detailed documentation for codebase, APIs, and deployment processes.

6. Agile Development :

- Participate in Agile methodologies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and methodologies.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Strong proficiency in .NET Core , ASP.NET , and C# .

- Expertise in front-end technologies such as HTML5 , CSS3 , JavaScript , and front-end frameworks like React , Angular , or Vue.js .

- Solid experience working with relational databases like SQL Server .

- Familiarity with version control tools like Git .

- Experience with RESTful API development and integration.

- Strong understanding of web security principles and best practices.

- Knowledge of cloud platforms like Azure or AWS is a plus.

- Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker ) and CI/CD pipelines is desirable.

Preferred Skills:

- Experience with front-end build tools and task runners (e.g., Webpack , Gulp ).

- Knowledge of Microservices architecture .

- Exposure to other back-end technologies like Node.js is a plus.

- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Consultor técnico sênior SAP ABAP
description:
Muito prazer, somos a Zallpy!

Somos muito mais que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos uma comunidade diversa, plural e talentosa. Nosso propósito é liderar a transformação digital, com excelência e agilidade, promovendo crescimento mútuo e genuíno em relações éticas e duradouras. Flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, atuamos em diferentes modelos e formatos de equipe, mantendo nossa cultura leve, colaborativa e integrada, proporcionando equidade de oportunidades em um espaço onde todos se sintam seguros e ouvidos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Analisar, projetar e desenvolver soluções utilizando ABAP em ambiente SAP;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas, propondo alternativas viáveis e eficientes;
  • Definir e validar temas de maior complexidade, como arquitetura e novas soluções;
  • Apoiar equipes de gestão, consultoria funcional e clientes, garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas e sugerindo melhorias contínuas;
  • Elaborar e manter a documentação dos projetos, assegurando rastreabilidade e boas práticas.

O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência comprovada em ABAP e no desenvolvimento de soluções SAP;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em lógica de programação, banco de dados e arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Vivência em projetos relacionados a módulo de Vendas e Distribuição (SD);
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos, com prazos desafiadores;

  • Conhecimento em processos de integração com diferentes sistemas.

  • Experiência com PI/PO;

Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota.

Modalidade de contratação:

  • CLT;
  • Cooperado.

Vale Alimentação/Refeição: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefício EVA, em formato crédito, para proporcionar flexibilidade nas suas compras diárias.*

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior
description:

Contract

description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

description:

1% a 10% de contratos de R$6.000 a R$60.000.


Benefícios da empresa: Participação nos Lucros, Cursos e Treinamentos


EXECUTIVO DE VENDAS / CLOSER


(OPORTUNIDADE PARA VENDEDORES)


Se você tem experiência com vendas 1:1 e já trabalhou em algum cargo comercial em empresas de marketing e/ou infoproduto, leia o texto abaixo.


Closer é uma função do setor COMERCIAL de uma Empresa Digital responsável pelas vendas diretas de produtos e/ou serviços de ticket alto (acima de 20k)


Sobre Nós

  • Somos apaixonados por resultados e nosso principal objetivo é ajudar instituições de ensino a crescerem de forma rentável e sustentável.
  • Somos a EdTech criadora do Gerador de Matrículas (GDM), a primeira metodologia completa para aquisição de novos alunos do Brasil.
  • Auxiliamos instituições de ensino em seus processos de expansão com base em três pilares fundamentais: Marketing de Performance, Automações Humanizadas e Vendas Consultivas.
  • Desenvolvemos tecnologias e metodologias exclusivas, e em apenas 1 ano, impactamos centenas de instituições em todo o país, transformando a maneira como atraem e convertem alunos.
  • Nosso trabalho vai além de estratégias convencionais: acompanhamos de perto nossos clientes, implementando processos que garantem escala com qualidade.
  • Entregamos isso por meio de nossa metodologia inovadora, de nossas ferramentas e de um suporte altamente personalizado.


Curiosidades

● Fundada em Dez/2020;

● Estamos em Porto Alegre / RS e nos reunimos 1x por mês presencialmente ;

● Saímos do zero absoluto, sem investidores, fundada por um Analista de Mídia de apenas 20 anos de idade;

● Nossa equipe com certeza já atendeu uma marca que você conhece;

● Antes de fundar a empresa, nossa equipe trabalhou para: Petrobras, Unilever, Renner, Insper, ESPM, Panvel, Gerdau e mais;

● Em 2024 faturamos o dobro do que fizemos entre 2021 e 2023, com menos de 10 pessoas na equipe;

● Nosso foco é lucro (dinheiro no bolso) e não faturamento (métrica de vaidade);

● Nosso lucro líquido cresceu 5x em 2024 e um de nossos produtos hoje bate mais 80% na margem de lucro;

● Se você busca um lugar para aprender, se desenvolver e crescer junto, essa é a oportunidade que você estava buscando.

● Nossa ambição, sem dúvidas, consegue cobrir seus maiores sonhos profissionais.


No que somos diferentes?

O mercado de Educação enfrenta um problema comum: a falta de responsabilidade pelos resultados. De um lado, agências de marketing geram leads, mas colocam a culpa no time de vendas quando os resultados não aparecem. Do outro, consultorias comerciais ensinam técnicas de vendas, mas atribuem o baixo desempenho ao marketing ou à equipe de vendas.

Somos a primeira empresa a assumir total responsabilidade pelos resultados. Nosso foco é único: gerar resultados reais. Utilizamos dados e testes constantes, que hoje compõem o Swipe File do GDM, para criar estratégias eficazes. Convidamos você a fazer parte de uma nova era no mercado educacional, onde o sucesso é uma questão de tempo, não de sorte.


A VAGA

Como Executivo de Vendas na PG Educação, você terá um papel fundamental no fechamento de vendas de nossos programas de mentorias e serviços de alto valor (high ticket) e na expansão de nossa base de clientes.

Sua responsabilidade inclui iniciar o contato com potenciais clientes de alto valor por meio de diversos canais, conduzir reuniões estratégicas (formato videochamada) para compreender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos sólidos e duradouros, negociar contratos e fechar acordos para maximizar os lucros.

Buscamos um profissional proativo, orientado para resultados e capacitado para contribuir significativamente para o crescimento contínuo de nossa base de clientes, especialmente nos nossos programas high ticket, assim como na venda de outros produtos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Atividades de Geração de Demanda (SDR, BDR, entre outros)
  • Realizar reuniões de vendas via videochamada para trabalhar oportunidades de venda;
  • Atuar como especialista dos nossos produtos e soluções;
  • Preencher e atualizar diariamente o CRM;
  • Fazer controle de performance;
  • Trabalhar e acompanhar metas e KPI´s;
  • Participar de reuniões diárias e/ou semanais com o time;
  • Negociar contratos e fechar vendas de ticket alto (20k+);
  • Fazer follow-up para fechamento de oportunidades;
  • Interagir com prospects via telefone, whatsapp e E-mail;
  • Alcançar ou superar consistentemente as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Focar no desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Colaborar com os membros da equipe para identificar e expandir oportunidades de vendas;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado, mudanças na indústria e estratégias dos concorrentes;


Colaboração:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para alinhar as estratégias de vendas com objetivo de bater as metas;


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ter experiência comprovada em vendas;
  • Saber trabalhar com metas;
  • Gostar de desafios e atingir metas;
  • Vontade inabalável de vencer e crescer;
  • Gostar da área comercial;
  • Conhecimento sólido das principais estratégias e táticas de vendas de programas high ticket ou serviços B2B.;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de análise e interpretação de métricas de desempenho em vendas e metas de receita;
  • Ser proativo(a);
  • Ser organizado(a), saber priorizar atividades e ter consistência;
  • Notebook próprio.


Diferenciais (não obrigatório para aplicação):

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas de programas de mentorias de alto valor (high ticket) ou em vendas B2B de serviços em times de Inside Sales em posições anteriores;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de venda SPIN Selling ou NEPQ


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Coachability: Abertura e facilidade em absorver e aplicar rapidamente o que foi treinado;
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em metas e compromisso com o sucesso das vendas;
  • Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de se ajustar a mudanças nas demandas e tendências de vendas;
  • Gestão do Tempo: Eficiência na organização e priorização de tarefas para cumprir prazos e metas estabelecidas.
  • Curiosity: A habilidade de entender o contexto de uma pessoa através de ESCUTA ATIVA e constante questionamento;
  • Prior success: Uma ou mais histórias de alta performance ou conquista;
  • Inteligente: A habilidade de aprender conceitos complexos rapidamente e comunicá-los de uma forma de entendimento simples;
  • Criatividade: Capacidade de pensar de forma inovadora e gerar ideias criativas para estratégias de vendas.


Regime de Contratação – PJ

  • Salário competitivo. Fixo R$2.500 + Variável
  • Participação nos Lucros.
  • Cursos e Treinamentos Constantes.
  • Possibilidade de se tornar Sócio(a).


APLICAÇÃO

• Você leu tudo que está escrito acima? Se não, volte e faça isso agora.

  • Leu? Se identificou? Acha que essa vaga pode ser pra você?
  • Então preencha o Formulário para se candidatar.

Boa sorte!

title: Analista de Dados PL/SR
description:
Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados com perfil analítico e forte domínio técnico, capaz de transformar dados em insights estratégicos e apoiar a tomada de decisão. O profissional atuará na construção de pipelines de dados, modelagem estatística e desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em Machine Learning em ambiente AWS .


Responsabilidades

  • Coletar, tratar e analisar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda, etc.) ;
  • Criar modelos preditivos e de machine learning utilizando Python (scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, etc.) ;
  • Automatizar processos de análise e geração de relatórios;
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio com dashboards e insights baseados em dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, integridade e governança dos dados.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com Python aplicado a análise e ciência de dados;
  • Vivência prática com serviços AWS (especialmente S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift e SageMaker);
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning , modelagem preditiva e estatística;
  • Domínio em SQL e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Familiaridade com versionamento de código (Git ) e metodologias ágeis.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, QuickSight ou Tableau);
  • Conhecimento em MLOps e arquiteturas de dados em nuvem ;
  • Certificação AWS (Data Analytics, Machine Learning ou Solutions Architect).

Perfil desejado

  • Raciocínio analítico e orientado a resultados;
  • Proatividade e curiosidade em explorar novas tecnologias;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir dados em informações estratégicas.

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities：

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.


Collaborate with the headquarters IT architecture team and local service providers to complete the purchases, installation, configuration, and upgrade of network equipment and low-voltage systems (e.g. CCTV, access control systems, racks, and cabling).


Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.


Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.


Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.


Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.

Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.


Requirements：

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.


At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.


Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP; VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN; and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.


Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.


Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.


Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.


Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.


Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.


Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.


Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Backend Developer (Ruby on Rails/Python)
description:
Think Dirty is seeking a highly skilled and product-minded full stack developer to enhance, scale, and evolve the backend and user-facing layers of our mobile app. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is passionate about clean code, and is excited to explore the integration of AI tools into modern product development.

You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and product leaders to build scalable infrastructure, optimize data pipelines, and drive innovation using emerging AI technologies.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable Ruby on Rails code across backend and full-stack systems
  • Build and maintain robust APIs (GraphQL/OpenAPI) to support our mobile and web applications
  • Explore and integrate AI tools (e.g., LLMs, vector search, embeddings, or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate product features and development workflow
  • Collaborate on architecture decisions, scaling infrastructure, and ensuring security best practices
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, bugs, and inefficiencies
  • Contribute to mobile development support for native iOS and Android
  • Partner with front-end and product teams to ship clean, AI-augmented features users love
  • Participate in the entire development cycle from ideation to deployment
  • Log hours and tasks to support SR&ED compliance and project visibility


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in backend API development using Ruby on Rails
  • Strong experience in full stack development (bonus: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Ember.js, React, Angular, or similar)
  • Proficiency with GraphQL, OpenAPI, and RESTful architectures
  • Advanced knowledge of Ruby 3, Rails 7, and PostgreSQL/MySQL
  • Experience deploying and maintaining apps on Heroku (or AWS/GCP equivalents)
  • Solid grasp of object-oriented programming, MVC, and ORM frameworks
  • Familiarity with AI APIs or tools (e.g., OpenAI, LangChain, Hugging Face) or a strong interest in learning
  • Working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud architecture
  • Strong experience in debugging, testing, and performance tuning
  • Comfort with code review, documentation, and collaborative engineering practices
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum workflows
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a growth mindset and product ownership mentality


Bonus Points For

  • Previous experience integrating AI/ML models into consumer-facing products
  • Contributions to open-source projects or developer communities
  • Experience with microservices architecture or serverless patterns
  • Familiarity with SOC2, GDPR, or other compliance frameworks
  • Mobile development (native or hybrid frameworks)


Who You Are

  • You believe code should be clean, readable, and purposeful
  • You’re a curious builder who sees AI not as a threat but as a tool to amplify great engineering
  • You love collaborating with product, design, and marketing to create impact
  • You thrive in fast-paced startup environments and take initiative
  • You’re eager to experiment, ship fast, and iterate even faster


To Apply

Please email your application to with the subject line:

“AI-Augmented Full Stack Developer Application – (Your Name)”

Include the following:

  • First & Last Name
  • Email
  • Location (City)
  • Resume/CV

We look forward to building the future of clean beauty tech with you.

title: Arquiteto de Dados e Soluções (Azure / .NET)
description:

● Aplicar princípios de sistemas distribuídos, incluindo particionamento, hash consistente e compensações do teorema CAP para construir sistemas resilientes e altamente disponíveis

● Projetar painéis e pipelines de análise em tempo real para fornecer insights atualizados em camadas transacionais e operacionais

● Liderar a adoção de padrões CQRS, SAGA e de origem de eventos para gerenciar o estado, suportar o reprocessamento de mensagens e obter consistência em contextos delimitados

● Projetar padrões de comunicação entre serviços com garantias de entrega única, lógica de repetição, filas de mensagens mortas e telemetria, garantindo observabilidade de ponta a ponta.

● Separe estrategicamente os fluxos com alta demanda de gravação e leitura por meio de gateways de API e processamento assíncrono apoiado por camadas de fluxo e cache.

● Oriente as equipes sobre quando escolher NoSQL ou SGBD relacional com base em padrões de acesso, requisitos de consistência e volatilidade do esquema.

● Escale sistemas baseados em SQL usando técnicas como réplicas de leitura, indexação de columnstore, fragmentação e pool de conexões.

● Oriente as equipes de engenharia, conduza revisões de código e design e garanta altos padrões em arquitetura, código e operações.


Requisitos


  • +8 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor em tecnologia.
  • +4 anos em arquitetura de dados, data lakes e nuvem (Azure) .
  • Experiência prática comprovada no fornecimento de sistemas corporativos na pilha Microsoft: .NET Core, Azure, Azure Service Bus, AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Functions
  • Experiência com soluções de dados do Azure, como Azure Synapse e Data Lake
  • Profundo conhecimento de estado distribuído, modelos de consistência (eventual, forte, sessão) e compensações de latência/falha no mundo real
  • Capacidade demonstrada de implementar sistemas e painéis escaláveis em tempo real com desempenho de nível de produção
  • Sólido conhecimento de sistemas de mensagens, estratégias de cache e arquiteturas de consistência híbridas
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões de design com base nos componentes internos do sistema - não apenas na configuração em nível de GUI
  • Compreensão de Conceitos Orientados a Objetos
  • Experiência em solucionar problemas e solucionar problemas relacionados ao desempenho em cenários com conjuntos de dados extremamente grandes
  • Experiência em solucionar problemas e solucionar problemas relacionados à integridade de dados em serviços com um número extremamente alto de transações
  • Compreensão e/ou experiência abrangentes com recursos de monitoramento e relatórios na nuvem Azure

title: BRAZIL LOCATION ONLY!!! - DevOps Engineer (Contract)
description:
